title: Houston sends Ky images at night about the film

tellings.quote: and I said I wrote Katie and I said does H is does Houston send me images at night about the movie can you ask him if he just did that and she wrote back and she asked Houston and Houston said yes I do s Kai Images

plain: In 2024, the filmmaker Ky Dickens says Houston, a young man who does not speak and who appears in her documentary The Telepathy Tapes, was sending her pictures in her mind at night about the film. She tells Michels that she wrote to his mother, Katie Asher, to check: "can you ask him if he just did that," and that Katie asked and Houston answered, "yes I do." To Dickens this was telepathy at work.
